NVIDIA has expanded its open‑source CUDA‑Q platform, adding features that broaden compatibility with a range of quantum hardware providers. The update introduces improved simulation fidelity, larger qubit support, and new libraries to streamline hybrid classical‑quantum workflows. NVIDIA also outlined a roadmap for the next phase of quantum development, focusing on higher performance and greater integration across existing AI and high‑performance computing ecosystems.
